scenario: A medicinal chemist evaluates a novel kinase inhibitor scaffold. First, chemistry-query retrieves the compound's properties and measured hERG IC50 from PubChem ChEMBL data. Next, admet-prediction runs a full ADMET safety profile including hERG liability assessment. Finally, reporting generates a lead-candidate brief summarizing whether the compound is safe to advance.
info_flow: chemistry-query retrieves compound properties and hERG IC50 from bioactivity databases, emitting a structured JSON payload with the measured value and its unit label → admet-prediction ingests the payload, applies hERG risk thresholds, and produces an ADMET safety classification → reporting synthesizes the classification into a lead-candidate advancement brief.
